description_en: Creates a named historical version for a dataset in a specified agent workspace to preserve the historical state of the dataset. You can call ListDatasetVersions to query version information. If a version is no longer needed, you can call DeleteDatasetVersion to delete the version
description_zh: 为指定智能体空间中的数据集创建命名历史版本，用于保留数据集的历史状态。可调用 ListDatasetVersions 查询版本信息；不再需要时，可调用 DeleteDatasetVersion 删除版本
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop create-dataset-version --agent-space my_agent_space --dataset-name product_faq_dataset --biz-version v1 --api-version 2026-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent workspace to which the dataset belongs. Specify the name of an existing agent workspace that you have permissions to access
parameters.help_zh: 数据集所属的智能体空间（AgentSpace）名称。请填写已存在且有权访问的智能体空间名称
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can call ListDatasets to obtain the name. The name must be 4 to 63 characters in length, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores. It cannot end with an underscore or contain consecutive underscores
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。可调用 ListDatasets 获取。名称长度为 4～63 个字符，以小写字母开头，仅包含小写字母、数字和下划线，不能以下划线结尾或包含连续下划线
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.example: 首次评估使用的数据集版本
parameters.help_en: The description of the version. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified, an empty string is used
parameters.help_zh: 版本描述。可选，不传时为空字符串
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the version to be created, which is used to identify the version within the current dataset. The name cannot be empty after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed. The length of the UTF-8 encoded name cannot exceed 128 bytes, and the name cannot contain forward slashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的版本名称，用于在当前数据集内标识版本。去除首尾空白后不能为空，UTF-8 编码长度不能超过 128 字节，且不能包含正斜线（/）
parameters.name: version

parameters.help_en: The optional client token that is generated and passed by the client. Do not use this token to determine whether the version is created. You can call ListDatasetVersions to query the version
parameters.help_zh: 可选的客户端请求标识，由客户端生成并传入。请勿将其作为版本创建成功的判断依据；可调用 ListDatasetVersions 查询版本
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The response information returned when the request is successful
schema.description_zh: 请求成功时返回的响应信息

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for creating a version, which includes the version name and an optional version description
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 创建版本的请求体，包含版本名称和可选的版本描述
v1_body_parameters.name: body
